app.command_palette.label: Command palette
app.command_palette.about: Ctrl K to search songs and run commands.

app.shortcuts.label: Single-key shortcuts
app.shortcuts.about: Keys like Space, N, M and R work without Ctrl held, listed under ?.

app.activity.label: Activity
app.activity.about: A list of recent changes, each with its own Undo.

app.glossary.label: Music terms
app.glossary.about: Plain explanations of the music words Selecta uses, and the small ? beside them.

app.theme_choice.label: Theme choice
app.theme_choice.about: Light, dark or match this computer.

app.motion_choice.label: Motion choice
app.motion_choice.about: Still, subtle or expressive movement. The computer's reduced-motion setting always wins.

app.auto_low_motion.label: Lower motion on a struggling device
app.auto_low_motion.about: When frames keep arriving late, decorative movement switches to Still for this visit. Nothing is hidden, and Workspace can bring full motion back.

app.classic_nav.label: Classic navigation
app.classic_nav.about: The older navigation labels over the same pages, with ?ui=classic as a way back.

app.scene_transitions.label: Page transitions
app.scene_transitions.about: With Expressive motion, pages move in the direction you went and shared things travel between them, where the browser supports it; otherwise they change at once.

app.feel_motion.label: Expressive feel
app.feel_motion.about: Springy presses and releases, things arriving from where they were asked, and Expressive as the starting motion level (ADR-0477). Off: today's quiet feedback, with Subtle as the starting level.

app.feel_depth.label: Depth and light
app.feel_depth.about: Lift shadows, lit edges and a glow on the main action, on the same colours as before (ADR-0477). Off: flat surfaces as before.

app.feel_pointer_light.label: Pointer light
app.feel_pointer_light.about: Cards and tiles show a soft light where the mouse is. Mouse only, and never the only sign of anything.

app.feel_music.label: Moves with the music
app.feel_music.about: While a mix plays, the Play control, the player bar and the playing row answer the measured beat of the real audio, and rest when it is paused (ADR-0477). Off: they stay still.

app.feel_ambient.label: Ambient colour
app.feel_ambient.about: A soft tint taken from the playing song, which travels to the next song's colour during a blend. Off: no tint.

app.feel_moments.label: Big moments
app.feel_moments.about: A short celebration at rare moments: setup finished, a mix built, the first blend heard, a room opened, a plan upgraded, an export ready. Off: the plain words only.

app.feel_haptics.label: Phone taps
app.feel_haptics.about: A light tap from the phone on key presses, on phones that can do it. Off: no taps.

app.install.label: Install as an app
app.install.about: Chrome and Edge can install Selecta as its own window.

app.attention_announce.label: Say when Workspace needs attention
app.attention_announce.about: When storage fills, analysis pauses with songs left, or a song or transition fails, a screen reader hears it once on whatever page is open. The header mark stays either way.
